Post-translational regulation of NLRP3 inflammasome licensing

Post-translational regulation of NLRP3 inflammasome licensing. NLRP3 licensing is regulated by phosphorylation (A), ubiquitination (B), acetylation (C), and SUMOylation and palmitoylation (D), which control the oligomerization of NLRP3 and further interaction with ASC and NEK7. These major modifications fine-tune inflammasome assembly, caspase-1 activation, and maturation of IL-1β/IL-18. A detailed mechanisms are discussed in the text, highlighting how diverse enzymes and signaling pathways dynamically coordinate PTMs of NLRP3. NLRP3,NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain-containing 3; PYD, pyrin domain; NACHT, central NAIP CIITA, HET-E, and TP1 domain; LRR, leucine-rich repeat; BTK, Bruton’s tyrosine kinase; Akt, protein kinase B (PKB); JNK, c-Jun N-terminal kinase; PKA, cAMP-dependent protein kinase A; PAK1, p21-activated kinase 1; PTPN22, protein tyrosine phosphatase non-receptor type 22; HUWE1, HECT, UBA and WWE domain–containing protein 1 (E3 ubiquitin ligase); Cbl-b, Casitas B-lineage lymphoma proto-oncogene-b (E3 ubiquitin ligase); TRIM31, tripartite motif–containing protein 31 (E3 ubiquitin ligase); Pellino-2, E3 ubiquitin–protein ligase Pellino 2 (PELI2); Cullin-1, CUL1 scaffold protein; GITR, glucocorticoid-induced TNF receptor (TNFRSF18); MARCH7, membrane-associated RING-CH 7 (axotrophin); PHGDH, phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase; KAT5, lysine acetyltransferase 5 (TIP60); SIRT2, sirtuin 2 (NAD-dependent deacetylase); HDAC, histone deacetylase; UBC9, SUMO-conjugating enzyme UBC9 (UBE2I); SENP3, sentrin/SUMO-specific protease 3; SENP6, sentrin/SUMO-specific protease 6; SENP7, sentrin/SUMO-specific protease 7; ZDHHC7, zinc finger DHHC-type palmitoyltransferase 7; ZDHHC17, zinc finger DHHC-type palmitoyltransferase 17 (HIP14); MAPL, mitochondrial-anchored protein ligase (also MUL1); ZDHHC5, zinc finger DHHC-type palmitoyltransferase 5; ZDHHC12, zinc finger DHHC-type palmitoyltransferase 12
